description: Fill in src/server/app.js (parseBbox, errorStatus, createServer on node:http with /api/health, /api/config, /api/cameras, /api/route, static files from publicDir, 10 kB body limit, {error, code} errors, no path traversal, server never crashes on a handler error) and src/server/main.js (configFromEnv for PORT, HOST, CAMERA_SOURCE, ROUTER, OFFLINE; main prints the documented start line). planRoutes, sources and routers are used via their interfaces; tests inject fakes and a temp publicDir and listen on port 0. summary: Implemented the node:http server (health, config, cameras, route, traversal-safe static files, 10 kB body limit, {error, code} errors, crash-proof handlers) and main.js (env config, start line, exit 1 on bad env or busy port); 111 unit tests in test/unit/api.test.js pass with npm test.
title: Implement HTTP server and entry point
